preservedResponsibilities: Native ODF group starts and ends divide the repeated row and column records, preserving nesting and visibility.
Repeating header wrappers split at native outline boundaries and retain their full interval on import.
Group closures resume the active print title before processing the next opening. Adjacent groups can therefore write an empty intervening title wrapper as described in CALC-784.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed outline editing commands and full host integration remain outside this filter checkpoint.

local.marker: keeps the four outline levels and hidden widths from LibreOffice outline.ods
reopens print titles around adjacent groups
